name: AEON
recent: Aeon Co. (M) Bhd. 在2026年11月20日公布了截至2026年9月30日的第三季度业绩，营收同比增长1.6%至10.11亿令吉，但净利同比下滑36.3%至930万令吉，主要受税务支出增加影响。同期，公司公告了固定资产注销事项。此外，雇员公积金局（EPF）在10月至11月间多次申报股权变动。
notable: 公布截至2026年9月30日的第三季度业绩，营收10.11亿令吉，净利930万令吉。
公告第三季度固定资产注销事项。
雇员公积金局（EPF）在2026年10月至11月间多次申报股权变动。
risks: 第三季度净利同比下滑36.3%，净利率从1.4%降至0.9%。
有新闻标题提及2027年盈利展望因装修和劳动力成本而被下调。
earnings: 2026年第三季度营收为10.11亿令吉，同比增长1.6%，环比增长1.6%；净利为930万令吉，同比下滑36.3%，环比下滑34.5%；净利率为0.9%，低于上一季度的1.4%。

recent_en: Aeon Co. (M) Bhd. announced its third-quarter results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 20 November 2026, with revenue up 1.6% year-on-year to MYR1.011 billion but net profit down 36.3% year-on-year to MYR9.3 million, mainly due to higher tax expenses. During the same period, the company announced a fixed assets write-off. In addition, the Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple notifications of changes in its shareholding between October and November.
notable_en: Announced third-quarter results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue of MYR1.011 billion and net profit of MYR9.3 million.
Announced a fixed assets write-off for the third quarter.
The Employees Provident Fund Board (EPF) filed multiple notifications of changes in its shareholding between October and November 2026.
risks_en: Third-quarter net profit fell 36.3% year-on-year, with net margin dropping from 1.4% to 0.9%.
A news headline mentioned that the 2027 earnings outlook was cut due to renovation and labour costs.
earnings_en: For the third quarter of 2026, revenue was MYR1.011 billion, up 1.6% year-on-year and up 1.6% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR9.3 million, down 36.3% year-on-year and down 34.5% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 0.9%, lower than 1.4% in the previous quarter.
